{{Quote|There's a group of bandits led by Trae Nedgarr, that call themselves the Nedgarr bandits. It's not exactly the most clever of names. Anyway, they damage my crops and steal my grain.|[[Pol Handerin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />}}
The '''Nedgarr Bandits''' were a group of criminals based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were named after their leader, [[Trae Nedgarr]], and had a [[Nedgarr Bandits hideout|hideout]] on the outskirts of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Nedgarr Bandits used to vandalize and rob local [[Farm/Legends|farms]], such as [[Pol Handerin]]'s [[Pol Handerin's farm|farm]].<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] dispatched a recruit to help Pol Handerin and deal with the Nedgarr Bandits. The CorSec agent recovered stolen grain and killed Trae Nedgarr during the assault of the Nedgarr Bandits Hideout.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nedgarr Bandits appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The Nedgarr Bandits were added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> They were part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />
